name: Industrial machinery mechanics
oneLiner: When the automation breaks, someone has to take it apart.
why: Every automation programme creates maintenance work
Fault diagnosis on real metal, in situ, under production pressure
446,900 people already do this — 79,700 more are projected
threats: Predictive maintenance removes some scheduled-inspection work
Employer-funded training is the bottleneck, not demand

claims.text: Projected to grow 17.8% to 2035, adding 79,700 jobs — one of the largest absolute additions in the fastest-growing table.
Demand is rising for complementary skills alongside AI fluency — quality assurance, process optimisation, teaching, and physical skills such as nursing and electrical work.
